notes.title: Update 1.7 - Nostalgia Map
notes.notes:
New Changes:

- New Map (Nostalgia)
This map is symmetrical. Using dynamic map elements to give and take away paths.
- Updated Map (Precipice)
Precipice's teleporter in room 3 has been raised off the ground, blockout geometry has been smoothed in areas bring the map more shape polish in line with Nostalgia
- New Teleporter
Teleporter now has a fancy new shader and frame, this makes it easier to see and more visually interesting.

Balancing -

The pistol and Burst Rifle have been combined into the 'Marksman Rifle' a slow firing full auto DMR. This is to reduce emphasis on TTK and precision and create a generally more engaging sandbox

Ammo can now be picked up from weapons on the floor, and players can no longer hold two of the same weapon.

Theres a lot of other changes but this is my first build since May so I forgot most of them lol

notes.title: Ver 1.3
notes.notes:
Game update - April 16th 2025 -
Balancing -
Burst Rifle is 3 bursts to headshot kill, 5 to bodyshot kill
Grenades no longer kill from one explosion

Bug fixing -
Added a temporary button to reset players profile saves on the main menu to combat the FOV / Sensitivity issue
New profiles no longer have 0 FOV and 0 Sensitivity
Fixed an issue with grenades falling beneath the floor when thrown at physics objects

UI / HUD -
Added a test name above players heads, this is work in progress and exists purely to see if there are any errors with its rendering
Added a countdown to the 'start match' button on the pre-match lobby menu. This should add to that 'iconic' feel

notes.title: Ver. 1.2
notes.notes:
Game update - April 15th 2025 -
Precipice map -
cannot grenade jump from balcony, however can still jump from roof holes (for now)

Customisation -
Can now adjust per-profile FOV and sensitivity

Menus - 
Have updated to a temporary menu, allowing for better customisation readability as well as increasing cool factor
Can now enter gamemode selection in the lobby menu to choose FFA, FFA shotguns or FFA snipers

Balancing -
Headshots re-enabled, however all weapons do headshot damage
Player health raised from 60 - 75
Player shield dropped from 100 - 75
Assault rifle damage raised from 9-10
Pistol rate of fire dropped from .25 ticks to .35 ticks
shotgun radius increased

Bug fixes -
Cannot get locked in the pause menu anymore
Customisation character model LOD issue fixed (I swear this time)
